Biography

Portrait · present day

J BOWMAN is a multi-platinum, Grammy-nominated songwriter, musician, composer and producer/engineer.

His career began in Chicago before taking him to California’s Bay Area, where he was signed to write and record with legendary producer Sandy Pearlman.

Since then, J has worked alongside artists and producers including David Foster, Kanye West, Chris Isaak, 2Pac, P!nk, Cake, Paul Rodgers, Dallas Austin, Don Was, Sam Hollander, George Clinton, Fatboy Slim and Rob Garza of Thievery Corporation.

His work with Michael Franti & Spearhead contributed to a catalogue of internationally recognised releases, including “Say Hey (I Love You),” “The Sound of Sunshine,” “Life Is Better With You” and “I’m Alive (Life Sounds Like).”

Beyond recorded music, J composes and produces for film, television, sport, advertising and multimedia. His work has appeared across Paramount, CBS, ABC, Disney and Warner Bros. productions.

Today, J brings decades of musical instinct and technical experience to collaborations across music, screen, fashion and contemporary culture.

One creative perspective. Every stage of sound.
